recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: telnet bulletin boards still flickering in terminal green
one prompt, six hours — an AI maps Calvino's invisible cities
Anne Carson awarded the Nobel in literature
clear autumn dusk over San Francisco, thirteen degrees
a quiet week — no commits, no posts, just imagining 2026

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Keep a dying telnet BBS alive by routing incoming ASCII packets into the right forum channels before the dial-up connection drops.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: swipe left or right to route each packet
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: every correct route reveals a fragment of a retro forum post
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: connection baud rate climbs and corrupted packets need double-taps to purge
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: phosphor green CRT terminal on black

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Trace invisible streets between drifting city islands — paths only solidify when you draw the route a wanderer might take through Calvino's unseen metropolis.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: drag finger to connect floating nodes
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: each completed path names a new impossible city in serif type
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: islands drift apart faster and fog hides endpoints mid-stroke

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Catch falling poem syllables in meter — tap on the beat as fragmented lines descend like ginkgo leaves before the stanza scatters.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: tap on beat markers as lines fall
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: completing a stanza blooms a brief verse on screen for one breath
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: tempo quickens and overlapping lines demand split-second choices
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: ink wash on cream paper with autumn leaf particles

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick agent orbs from a phone shortcut dock toward sunrise deadlines on a horizontal timeline — each landing triggers a micro ship burst before dawn.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: flick upward at angle to launch orbs
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: watching an orb land and 'ship' a tiny feature in thirty seconds
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: more tasks spawn and the sunrise deadline creeps leftward
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: dawn gradient with minimal blueprint wireframes
